_comment: Template for backend/benchmarks/benchmark_provider_import.py, the read-only audit of
real provider deliveries. Copy this file to scripts/provider-import-paths.json, which
is gitignored, and point the paths at your own data. Provider deliveries must not reach
the repository or CI, so only this template is committed.
Each entry needs exactly three keys: name, provider and path. Any other key, including
name     a label for the report; it is what identifies the row, so keep it neutral.
provider one of: generic, iceye, capella, umbra, pleiades_neo, worldview, blacksky.
path     the root of the delivery. ~ is expanded. The audit calls stat() and may open
small metadata sidecars; it never reads pixels and never writes to the source.
A source that is not reachable is reported as SKIPPED_REAL_DATA rather than silently
passing, so an incomplete config degrades honestly. If no source at all is reachable,
By default the report carries the path of every source. Pass --anonymize to replace
the paths with stable hashes before sharing the report outside your machine.
